scope: Candidate relations overlap; no transitive closure of shared inputs, no semantic identity or automatic ordered version.

family_evidence.rule: At least two distinct consumers of one exact material asset, Study 07 preset exclusion; broad screen only, no revision-pair comparisons
At least two jobs of the same nonempty literal type with the same complete nonempty material-asset-ID set; roles, references and controls remain separate
At least two jobs with one nonempty compound film/batch ID; no inferred simultaneity
One unambiguous existing different producer and one actual material consumer; one pair per generation edge regardless of role/path multiplicity
Adjacent dated nonempty primary requests within literal type/model, at least ten distinct whitespace tokens each, token-set Jaccard >=0.8 and elapsed event gap <=24h; no lineage introduced

modes.rule: Batch/shared-input alternatives are candidates without established revision order; actual parallel execution is unknown

Corpus candidate requires equal nonempty primary text, same nonempty type/model and complete nonempty material input set; other controls may differ. Original panel codes retain their broader shared-input interpretation
Named source-conditioned request restricts changed properties/region; no mask, defect or correction success implied
Requires named comparable members and an explicit task/objective change, not low similarity or a different model; no established panel 09.2 assignment
Different nonempty literal IDs on compared members; observation of model difference, intention remains unknown

delta_rules.text: Only two nonempty primary fields are comparable; exact equality retains all whitespace/case; token additions/deletions are case-sensitive whitespace-token multiset changes, not edit distance or semantic deltas
delta_rules.specificity: Named scoped case interpretation only; longer_text is length growth, never specificity
delta_rules.preservation: Unchanged AF3a regex absent->present/present->absent on comparable texts; semantic case interpretation separate
delta_rules.inputs: Exact material asset sets added/removed; both nonempty differences is input_replacement_candidate, not proven same-property replacement; role/reference/path tuple differences separate
delta_rules.controls: Compare canonical top-level scalar parameters excluding enumerated text/media fields and all containers; only valid JSON objects comparable; full raw fields stay in snapshot
delta_rules.order: Producer->consumer for lineage; UTC timestamp then ID adjacency for batch/input_set; timestamp adjacency for similarity. This is comparison order, never evidence of a revision decision. Pair duplicates collapse within basis, not across bases.
delta_rules.adoption: A job's output has at least one actual different material consumer. No later export edge means no observed adoption, never rejection. No approval inferred.

dependencies.04: Semantic components, comparable task context and preservation/specificity/direction interpretation
dependencies.12: Controlled validation of family interpretation and review/retry proposals
